correctness.rationale: Every word exactly spells an Euler trail of the labeled undirected multigraph with edge multiplicities equal to its unordered pair-composition spectrum, and conversely. Its realization conditions are precisely connected active support and zero/two odd vertices. Parity-edge splitting gives an exact rational graph-generating function. Möbius inversion on set partitions removes all disconnected support, after which a finite active-alphabet sum gives the all-q formula. The q=4 closed form is confirmed by exact polynomial cross multiplication, not coefficient guessing. The incidence map has rank q-1 over F_2; its allowed parity fraction is (1+binom(q,2))/2^(q-1), while disconnected spectra have one fewer free edge coordinate and vanish in density. Independent graph enumeration and word enumeration corroborate first coefficients, but they do not replace the infinite proof.
